experiments.rejected: Weak static fallback; initial illegal prefetch corrected and raw failures retained; most universal absolute values, endpoint-survival weighting, residual fits, deeper continuation sampling, redundant-cache cleanup and memory-order alternatives did not beat the selected full-contract train result. Compact nonlinear fitting improved supervised error but did not beat the best native train cost.

limitations: Private final v2 streams/seeds and reference/scoring were never accessed; final generalization and official reward are unmeasured.
Public templates cover24-118 nodes but the visible task has four program families; no arbitrary-graph global-optimality claim.
Value fitting approximates joint reconstruction/eviction and uses finite sampled public-law continuations; CPU-adaptive candidate interruption can cause small native-cost variation.

In-process timings include research replay and exclude startup; final selection/reporting uses complete current-only subprocess checks. These development tools are not claimed to be a formal container harness or official RSI acceptance.
remaining_headroom: Per-node first-use-before-eviction survival estimators could improve on aggregate cache displacement features.
More efficient deterministic multi-step law planning and tighter joint host/device reconstruction could improve cost while retaining a complete cheap fallback.
The research budget is not exhausted; broad algorithm and critic experiments reached a plateau among the tested approaches. No unmeasured improvement is claimed.
